faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about WhatsApp ordering.

items.question: Do I need a special WhatsApp account?
items.answer: No. WhatsApp orders work with any WhatsApp number — personal or WhatsApp Business. Just add your phone number in the dashboard, and you're ready to receive orders.

items.question: Are there any commissions or per-order fees?
items.answer: Absolutely not. IQ Rest never charges commissions on your orders. You pay only your subscription plan, and all revenue from orders stays with you.

items.question: Can customers customize their order or add notes?
items.answer: Yes. Guests can select items, specify quantities, and add special notes or requests. Everything is included in the WhatsApp message you receive.

items.question: Does it work for dine-in, takeaway, and delivery?
items.answer: Yes. WhatsApp ordering works for all scenarios. For dine-in, guests scan the QR code at their table. For takeaway or delivery, you can share a direct link to your menu.
